svg.title: times-03-grizzly-population
svg.desc: Historical recreation, close-up p.4 bottom left; Times Review; 1997-10-22. Grey tone and recurring emblems normalized. Historical copy.

g.aria-label: grizzly bears, which is about half of all the
grizzlies in Canada, and one quarter of all the
grizzlies in North America. Over 60% of the
remaining grizzly bear habitat in Canada is
designated as either vulnerable or threatened,
and all is considered to be at risk.
For more information contact Revelstoke’s Bear
